model_meta.description: Concept model of a scroll compressor architecture with orbiting-scroll discharge and bypass openings routed through a frame passage to the discharge space.

subsystems.description: Compressor casing containing suctioning and discharging spaces separated by a frame; suction and discharge connections are described in the embodiment.
Fixed scroll secured in the casing, including a fixed wrap and disk; the wrap engages the orbiting wrap and has varying thickness along the compression path.

Orbiting scroll with a disk and orbiting wrap whose thickness varies along the compression path; it has compression-related discharge and bypass holes and a coupling portion receiving the shaft eccentric portion.

interfaces.interface_type: bypass valve coupled to bypass hole

subsystems.description: Driver rotates a shaft whose eccentric portion couples to the orbiting scroll and produces its orbiting motion.
Frame within the casing that separates suctioning and discharging spaces and provides a passage communicating with both orbiting-scroll discharge and bypass holes to the discharging space.
Optional valve respectively coupled to a bypass hole and configured to open the hole when pressure in the hole exceeds a predetermined value.

item_flows.name: Refrigerant in compression chambers
item_flows.notes: Refrigerant is sucked and compressed in changing-volume chambers formed by the engaged wraps; its external intake source is not specified by the claims.

item_flows.name: Discharged refrigerant
item_flows.notes: Compressed refrigerant passes through the orbiting-scroll discharge hole and frame passage to the discharging space; claims 1 and 13.

item_flows.name: Bypass refrigerant
item_flows.notes: Bypass flow passes through an orbiting-scroll bypass hole and the frame discharge passage to the discharging space; claims 1 and 13.

item_flows.name: Shaft rotation
item_flows.notes: Driver rotates shaft; eccentric portion is coupled to the orbiting scroll.

requirements.statement: Provide a frame passage that communicates both the orbiting-scroll discharge hole and at least one bypass hole with the compressor discharging space.
requirements.rationale: Independent claims 1 and 13 recite routing both openings to the discharging space through a frame passage.

requirements.statement: When included, configure a bypass valve to open its bypass hole when pressure in that hole exceeds a predetermined value.
requirements.rationale: Dependent claims 9 and 17; valve is optional in claims 8 and 16.

steps.description: The driver rotates the shaft and its eccentric portion drives the coupled orbiting scroll.
The orbiting wrap engages the fixed wrap to define compression chambers whose volumes change as the orbiting scroll moves, sucking and compressing refrigerant.
Communicate the orbiting-scroll discharge hole and bypass hole(s) through the frame discharge passage to the discharging space.

actions.name: Open bypass hole on pressure threshold

steps.description: Open the coupled bypass hole when pressure in that hole exceeds a predetermined value.
